entry.title: New: Bill 27 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 2, ARTICLE 45, SECTION 2-235, OF THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO THE GENERAL EXCISE AND USE TAX SURCHARGE

Adds County-appropriated housing infrastructure costs and the definition of “Housing infrastructure costs” to use of funds to codify the Session Laws of Hawaiʻi 2024, Act 30, which took effect on July 1, 2024.

Latest action: Council: Bill 27, Draft 2 passes second & final reading - 3/19/25
